note: Reach bands are order-of-magnitude buckets of monthly active Indian users (S <1M, M 1-10M, L 10-50M, XL 50M+) meant for ranking, not reporting. Entries with verify:true are best guesses from public claims and press; check before quoting. Tag vocabulary is deliberately small; see README.

surfaces.name: Moneycontrol
surfaces.wayIn: Pitch a tool that keeps users on-page longer (calculators, trackers). Editorial and product teams both need engagement, so go to product first.

surfaces.name: Livemint
surfaces.wayIn: Explainer content plus an embedded tool under the Money and Personal Finance sections; the desk likes calculators it can link from stories.
surfaces.example: Dezerv tracker on Mint Money pages

surfaces.name: ET Markets (Economic Times)
surfaces.wayIn: Offer a screener or market tool for the ET Markets app; the partnerships desk is active and will trade placement for exclusive data.

surfaces.name: Business Standard
surfaces.wayIn: Sponsored explainers and a data widget on the Markets page; the reader is older and paywalled, so pitch credibility, not reach.

surfaces.name: Financial Express
surfaces.wayIn: Personal finance calculators (SIP, tax, EMI) already drive their search traffic; offer a better one with your brand on it.

surfaces.name: NDTV Profit
surfaces.wayIn: The relaunched app is still building tools; pitch a co-branded market widget or a weekly explainer slot on the app home.

surfaces.name: Zee Business (app and Hindi TV)
surfaces.wayIn: Hindi retail traders watch it live; a stock or F&O tool referenced on air and linked in the app pulls tier-2 intent.

surfaces.name: Dainik Bhaskar app
surfaces.wayIn: Hindi utility content (government schemes, savings, gold price) in the app's Business section; low finance intent, but the audience is exactly tier-2 India.

surfaces.name: Inshorts
surfaces.wayIn: Native card formats; pitch a daily utility card, not an ad. The product team will A/B it on retention.

surfaces.name: Dailyhunt
surfaces.wayIn: Publish as a vernacular content partner in 10 languages; utility cards on the feed are sold by the ads team but can be bartered for content.

surfaces.name: Google Discover
surfaces.wayIn: Publish fast, image-led explainers on your own domain and follow Discover guidelines; there is no partnership, only content quality and freshness.

surfaces.name: PhonePe
surfaces.wayIn: PhonePe Switch mini-app marketplace; you need a transactional use case (buy, pay, book) or it will not clear review.

surfaces.name: Paytm
surfaces.wayIn: Mini-app store; strongest for merchant-side products because the Paytm for Business app is where shop owners already live.

surfaces.name: Google Pay (India)
surfaces.wayIn: Spot experiences (branded mini-flows) need a Google BD sponsor and a long approval cycle; worth it only if your product is a payment itself.

surfaces.name: BHIM
surfaces.wayIn: NPCI-owned, so the route is a UPI use-case partnership (UPI Lite, AutoPay mandates), not a placement deal.

surfaces.name: Amazon Pay
surfaces.wayIn: Bill payments and Amazon Pay Later are the hooks; pitch a recurring bill category or a rewards tie-in through their merchant team.

surfaces.name: MyJio
surfaces.wayIn: Enterprise partnership route through Jio Platforms; long cycle, but a MyJio tile puts you in front of prepaid India every recharge.

surfaces.name: Airtel Thanks
surfaces.wayIn: Airtel Thanks bundles third-party apps as rewards; pitch a free-tier bundle so Airtel can market it as a perk to prepaid users.

surfaces.name: OEM preloads (Xiaomi GetApps, Samsung Galaxy Store, Vivo)
surfaces.wayIn: Preload and app-store featuring deals are bought per device, but GetApps and Galaxy Store featured slots can be bartered if your install-to-active ratio is good.

surfaces.name: Groww
surfaces.wayIn: Groww does not host third-party widgets; the way in is complementary content (their blog and YouTube) or being a product they distribute (NPS, bonds, insurance).

surfaces.name: Zerodha Kite (Kite Connect)
surfaces.wayIn: Build on Kite Connect and list in the Zerodha ecosystem page; Zerodha also seeds Rainmatter startups, which gets you a mention on their blog.
surfaces.example: smallcase and Sensibull started as Kite ecosystem apps

surfaces.name: Zerodha Varsity
surfaces.wayIn: Guest modules and tool references; credibility over reach. Varsity does not take paid placement, so the content has to be genuinely useful.

surfaces.name: Upstox
surfaces.wayIn: Upstox runs a developer API and a busy referral program; pitch a tool that improves their trader activation and ask for an in-app link.

surfaces.name: Kuvera
surfaces.wayIn: Small, loyal, DIY investors; Kuvera cross-promotes partners (US stocks, insurance, tax) as tabs, so pitch a product they cannot build.

surfaces.name: CRED
surfaces.wayIn: CRED Store and member offers; premium positioning required. They ask for an exclusive coin-redemption deal before any placement.

surfaces.name: Jupiter
surfaces.wayIn: Neobank with a savings-and-insights audience; pitch a feature they can white-label (goals, tax, credit) inside their Money tab.

surfaces.name: Fi
surfaces.wayIn: Fi already bundles MF, US stocks and jars from partners; go through their partnerships team with a revenue share, not a placement fee.

surfaces.name: slice
surfaces.wayIn: Young credit-line users in metros and tier-2; offers inside the slice app are merchant-style deals, so bring a discount, not content.

surfaces.name: INDmoney
surfaces.wayIn: Positioned as a super-app for money; they add partner products as tabs (US stocks, NPS, loans). Pitch a category they do not have.

surfaces.name: ET Money
surfaces.wayIn: Owned by Times Internet, so a deal here can be bundled with ET Markets editorial; pitch a tool plus content package to Times Internet BD.

surfaces.name: Paytm Money
surfaces.wayIn: Access is via the Paytm mini-app store rather than Paytm Money itself; a broking or MF tool can be listed and deep-linked from the Paytm home.

surfaces.name: smallcase
surfaces.wayIn: Publish research or a themed smallcase through a registered RA or RIA partner; smallcase Gateway lets you embed their checkout on your side too.

surfaces.name: Tickertape
surfaces.wayIn: Research-led audience; contribute data to their screener or sponsor a Tickertape Learn series. Same group as smallcase, so one BD conversation.

surfaces.name: Angel One
surfaces.wayIn: SmartAPI plus a large sub-broker network; pitch a tool their authorised persons can use with clients and Angel will push it internally.

surfaces.name: Paisabazaar / BankBazaar
surfaces.wayIn: Credit-score checkers with huge SEO traffic; run an affiliate listing if you lend, or a content tie-in if you help people improve their score.

surfaces.name: Policybazaar
surfaces.wayIn: Insurance buyers are life-event buyers (marriage, child, home); a tool that sits next to the quote flow reaches them at the moment they plan money.

surfaces.name: WhatsApp Communities
surfaces.wayIn: Business API bots and admin-run communities; retention channel more than acquisition. Ask a partner with an existing community to add your bot, not to promote you.

surfaces.name: WhatsApp Business (click-to-chat, Flows)
surfaces.wayIn: Use WhatsApp Flows for onboarding inside chat and click-to-chat ads from Meta; the fastest path to tier-2 users who will not install another app.

surfaces.name: Telegram finance channels
surfaces.wayIn: Sponsor or run a utility bot (price alerts, results calendar); be careful with compliance because many channels sell unregistered tips.

surfaces.name: YouTube finance creators
surfaces.wayIn: Tool integrations inside creator content (the creator uses your product on screen); SEBI ad-code rules apply, so keep it a tool, not a recommendation.

surfaces.name: Instagram finance creators
surfaces.wayIn: Reels with a screenshot of your product beat sponsored posts; work with 20 mid-size creators on a fixed fee plus tracked link, not two big ones.

surfaces.name: X (Twitter) fintwit
surfaces.wayIn: Founder posts with real data and screenshots; fintwit rewards transparency and punishes ads. Reply-guys with charts get more reach than launch threads.

surfaces.name: Finshots and Zerodha newsletters
surfaces.wayIn: Finshots sells a single sponsor slot per issue and its reader is a salaried explainer-reader; pitch a one-line utility, not a brand ad.

surfaces.name: Independent finance newsletters (Substack, Beehiiv)
surfaces.wayIn: Sponsor five to ten niche newsletters in the same month; small numbers, but the readers are exactly the affluent DIY investor and they click.

surfaces.name: LinkedIn India
surfaces.wayIn: Founder-led content and a newsletter; best for B2B and salaried personas. Comments from people at target companies are the lead list.

surfaces.name: ShareChat
surfaces.wayIn: Vernacular creator programs in 15 languages; low finance intent, high reach. Use it for awareness in one language first and measure installs before scaling.

surfaces.name: Moj
surfaces.wayIn: Short video with the same creators who post on Instagram; brief them in their language and let them use your product on camera.

surfaces.name: Josh (Dailyhunt)
surfaces.wayIn: Bundle with a Dailyhunt content deal; Josh creator campaigns are sold by the same VerSe team, so negotiate both in one contract.

surfaces.name: Vernacular microblogs (Koo successors)
surfaces.wayIn: Koo shut down in 2024 and no successor has scale; treat this as a watch item, and post in Hindi on X instead for the same audience.

surfaces.name: Reddit (r/IndiaInvestments, r/personalfinanceindia)
surfaces.wayIn: Earn trust with transparent tools and an AMA; no shilling, and disclose who you are. Mods will ban a stealth post within the hour.

surfaces.name: Quora (India finance topics)
surfaces.wayIn: Answer the top 50 questions in your category with a real answer and one link; Quora answers rank on Google for years.

surfaces.name: Discord (trading and college servers)
surfaces.wayIn: Ship a bot that does one thing (alerts, a quick calculator) and offer it to server admins; you get the server, they get a feature.

surfaces.name: ValuePickr forum
surfaces.wayIn: Serious long-term investors who write 3,000-word posts; share data or a research tool for free and let the forum find it. Never advertise.

surfaces.name: College clubs and placement cells
surfaces.wayIn: Campus ambassador programs; cheap, slow, loyal. Placement cells will host a session if you frame it as first-salary planning.

surfaces.name: Payroll providers (Zoho Payroll, Keka, greytHR, RazorpayX)
surfaces.wayIn: Distribute via payroll and benefits providers; one deal puts you in the payslip email or the employee app for thousands of users at once.

surfaces.name: Corporate employers (HR and benefits)
surfaces.wayIn: Sell a free financial wellness session to HR and run it on payday week; the deck is the pitch, the sign-up link is the product.

surfaces.name: Chartered accountant networks
surfaces.wayIn: CAs advise both salaried filers and small businesses at tax time; give them a partner dashboard and a referral fee and they bring their whole client book.

surfaces.name: RIAs and mutual fund distributors
surfaces.wayIn: Around 1.5 lakh active MFDs already have clients' trust; a white-label or co-branded tool they can show clients gets you distribution without a consumer brand.

surfaces.name: Gig worker apps (Swiggy, Zomato, Urban Company partner apps)
surfaces.wayIn: Platforms want to offer earnings-linked savings, insurance and credit; pitch the platform's partner-welfare team, not the consumer side.

surfaces.name: Flipkart
surfaces.wayIn: Flipkart runs a fintech tab (Pay Later, insurance) with partner products; you need a licensed product and a revenue share, not a widget.

surfaces.name: Amazon India
surfaces.wayIn: Amazon does not embed third parties on the shopping surface; the way in is Amazon Pay partnerships or the Appstore on Fire TV, both slow.

surfaces.name: Meesho
surfaces.wayIn: Meesho resellers are home-based women sellers; pitch a seller-side benefit (payouts, savings, insurance) through Meesho's supplier team.

surfaces.name: Swiggy / Zomato
surfaces.wayIn: Cross-sell surfaces and loyalty tie-ins (Swiggy One, Zomato Gold); hard to get, huge if landed. Start with a co-branded card or coupon, not a tab.

surfaces.name: Ola / Uber
surfaces.wayIn: Two audiences: riders (commuters) and drivers (gig earners); driver-side financial products get a warmer reception from the platform.

surfaces.name: Quick commerce (Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart)
surfaces.wayIn: Order-confirmation and delivery-tracking screens are the inventory; pitch a post-order card with a clear offer to their monetisation team.

surfaces.name: Dream11
surfaces.wayIn: Match-day traffic spikes; a sponsorship on Dream11 content or a partner offer during IPL reaches young men who already move money in-app.

surfaces.name: MPL and other real-money gaming
surfaces.wayIn: Withdrawals are the moment; pitch a savings or UPI product at cash-out. The 2023 GST change shrank this category, so check reach first.

surfaces.name: Practo
surfaces.wayIn: Health spending is a money moment; pitch health insurance or medical-loan tools next to the consultation flow through their partnerships team.

surfaces.name: Unacademy
surfaces.wayIn: Exam-prep students become first-salary earners in two years; sponsor a free course on money basics and keep the emails.

surfaces.name: Physics Wallah
surfaces.wayIn: Hindi-medium students at scale; a free 'first job, first money' module in Hindi inside the PW app is the pitch, with parents as the second audience.

surfaces.name: DigiLocker
surfaces.wayIn: Not a marketing surface; integrate as a document requester to cut KYC drop-off, and get listed on the DigiLocker partners page.

surfaces.name: ONDC
surfaces.wayIn: Join as a buyer or seller app on the network; reach comes from the other apps on ONDC, and the fastest route is a financial services use case.

surfaces.name: Account Aggregator ecosystem (Sahamati, Finvu, OneMoney)
surfaces.wayIn: Register as a FIU to pull consented bank data; distribution comes from co-marketing with AAs and lenders who already use the rails.

surfaces.name: Google Search (organic)
surfaces.wayIn: Programmatic pages for every calculator, fund, stock and scheme name; Indian finance SEO is crowded but long-tail queries still convert.

surfaces.name: Bing and Copilot search
surfaces.wayIn: Small share, but desktop office users default to it; ensure your calculators are indexed and cited by Copilot answers.

surfaces.name: Google Play (featured and collections)
surfaces.wayIn: Apply for editorial featuring around a moment (tax season, IPL, Diwali) via your Play partner manager; a collection slot beats any paid install campaign.

surfaces.name: Spotify podcasts (finance shows)
surfaces.wayIn: Host-read ads on five mid-size finance podcasts, each with a promo code; cheap tests, and hosts will often guest you on the show.

surfaces.name: JioSaavn
surfaces.wayIn: Audio ads sold with the Jio bundle; better used as a regional-language branding channel than a direct-response one.

surfaces.name: JioHotstar
surfaces.wayIn: IPL and cricket sponsorship is priced for large brands; a mid-stage startup gets in through a co-branded segment or a Jio bundle, not media buy.

surfaces.name: YouTube (non-finance, mass)
surfaces.wayIn: Regional comedy, vlog and news creators reach tier-2 households that finance creators never will; brief them on a single use case in their language.
